//ApiBaseUrl: The API this web app calls. (1) The host is api-site.runasp.net - the Monster host name the API is actually published to, not the verichat-crm-api name earlier drafts assumed. (2) The scheme is cleartext http: measured 2026-11-01, https to this host fails at the TLS handshake (curl rc=35) because no certificate is bound (DEPLOYMENT.md 5 and 7). This web site is in the same boat - https://verichat-crm-web.runasp.net also fails the handshake and only http returns 200 - so no page is loaded over https today and there is no mixed-content problem. Bind a certificate to both sites and change both origins together before shipping; an https page calling an http API would be blocked as mixed content.
